supersedes_claim: Initial populated-settings-harness-review.json claimed separate HTML artifact isolation; deeper installed dependency inspection disproves that claim for the initial helper. Initial source approvals for fresh state/API/browser selection/hidden upload remain valid.
outcome: block artifact isolation approval until child HTML output env is overridden

finding.trigger: Outer e2e-artifact.py exports PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=<outer>/html-report and helper child env inherits os.environ.
finding.effect: Playwright1.63 HTML reporter resolves environment folder before config outputFolder, then removes that directory at every onEnd. Second prepared-settings run deletes the first fresh-install HTML report instead of retaining both. JSON and screenshots are separately directed but do not prove that HTML report survives.
finding.evidence: Installed lockfile-matching playwright1.63.0 lib/runner/index.js::_resolveOptions line3447 uses reportFolderFromEnv() ?? config option; onEnd line3473 awaits removeFolders2([this._outputFolder]); reportFolderFromEnv line3506 reads PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR first.
finding.fix: Set child PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR to args.output / html-<project> (or remove inherited override so exact config folder applies). Bind PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE to expected results-project.json to avoid an inherited reporter override as well.
finding.validation_required: Source-read the repaired child env and actual CI artifacts must contain separate complete first-run and prepared-run reports; downloaded SHA256SUMS must include all files.

execution: Dependency/source read only, no build/browser/container/lint or isolated test addition.
